title: Photographing the stone head
logline: Tourist Season: a tourist crouched with a phone at the stone head in the grass, the first person in the run to look at it on purpose. The page watches from the alley's end.

panels.composition: From the alley's end: a tourist in fleece crouched with a phone before the moss-grown stone head in the grass by the shingle wall, a bait cooler beside it, August light.
